evidence: Existing Type-0x17 actor-template and palette-source identities
limitations: The promoted name identifies the creation and palette behavior but does not assign a user-facing name to the Type-0x17 object.

conclusion: The shared five-selector Type-0x17 interaction handler now has a stable creation-and-palette identity while preserving its exact camera gate.
